title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
inputFormat:
Line 1: integer n, the number of days.
Line 2: n space-separated integers, prices[i] is the price on day i.
outputFormat: A single integer: the maximum profit achievable, or 0 if no profitable trade exists.

examples.explanation: Buy on day 1 at price 1 and sell on day 4 at price 6 for a profit of 5.
Prices only fall, so no transaction is made and the profit is 0.
